t: Exceptional Engineering S1 - "Mega Cranes"
d: Engineers in Hamburg design and assemble massive mega-cranes capable of lifting heavy 750-ton loads into hard-to-reach locations.

t: Bridging the Expanse S1 - "The Making and Breaking of Icons"
st: The Making and Breaking of Icons
d: Wartime logistics and post-war suburban growth drive the creation of longer, functional bridge spans designed to handle modern motor traffic.

t: Beyond Our Earth S1 - "Beyond the Belts"
d: Voyager and Cassini missions tour the outer solar system, investigating gas giants, icy moons, Pluto, and a hypothetical Planet Nine.

t: Beyond Our Earth S1 - "Searching The Heavens"
d: Telescopic innovations from Galileo to Hubble and James Webb expand cosmic maps, revealing distant galaxies and habitable exoplanets.

t: How Do They Do It S14 - "Aluminium Cans, Cuckoo Clocks, Paddleboards"
d: An insight into how used aluminium cans are turned into planes and rockets, and the carving of a traditional Black Forest cuckoo clock.

t: How Do They Do It S14 - "Car Shredder, Sarees, Worcestershire Sauce"
d: How do they build the ultimate car crushing colossus? Plus, how do Lea and Perrins concoct their Worcestershire sauce?

t: How Do They Do It S14 - "Mardi Gras, Rock Candy, Dentures"
d: A look at how the amazing, and massive, decorations on Mardi Gras carnival floats are created, how rock candy is twisted together, and a look at how dentures are made.

t: Bright Now S1 - "Predicting A Pro"
d: Increasingly high-tech tools are being used to evaluate youth baseball players. The question is can they outperform professional scouts?

t: Extremes S1 - "Tall Buildings, Fast Animals and Expensive Cities"
st: Tall Buildings, Fast Animals and Expensive Cities
d: In this episode of Extremes, we explore tall buildings, fast animals, expensive cities and extremely impressive basketball records.

t: Extremes S1 - "Long Lives, Destructive Weather and Speed Records"
st: Long Lives, Destructive Weather and Speed Records
d: In this episode of Extremes, you will learn about extreme close-up photography, long lives, destructive weather and speed records.

t: Extremes S1 - "Physics, Space and Wealth"
d: In this episode of Extremes, we’ll explore all things extreme in physics, space and wealth plus take a look at the smallest creatures on Earth.

t: Extremes S1 - "Largest Animals, Human Bodies and Football"
st: Largest Animals, Human Bodies and Football
d: In this episode of Extremes, we will be exploring the largest animals, extreme facts about the human body and record breaking extremes in football and the field of music.

t: Battle Factory S1 - "An Assault Rifle, a Bomb Suit, a Mortar, and a Zodiac"
st: An Assault Rifle, a Bomb Suit, a Mortar, and a Zodiac
d: What starts off as a seven-pound bar of solid steel will soon deliver a bullet with deadly accuracy when it becomes the barrel of a Colt C7 assault rifle, and when plastic and bulletproof fabric are molded and stitched together,they’ll make a suit of armour made for the most dangerous job in the world.

t: Battle Factory S1 - "A Parajet, a Hovercraft, a Camo Jacket, and a Portable Military Shelter"
st: A Parajet, a Hovercraft, a Camo Jacket, and a Portable Military Shelter
d: As lightweight aluminum is cut and tooled, it will become the frame of a personal flying machine. Used by military operatives, drug enforcement agents, and first responders – it gets you in and out fast, whether you are carrying a camera or a gun.

t: Battle Factory S1 - "A Sniper Rifle, a Zeppelin, a Ka-Bar Knife, and Dragon Eggs"
st: A Sniper Rifle, a Zeppelin, a Ka-Bar Knife, and Dragon Eggs
d: In 48 hours, a block of metal will be formed into the most accurate weapon on earth: the AX-338 Sniper Rifle. In a warzone, police stand off, or hostage taking, the sniper is often the only solution to a bad situation.

t: Battle Factory S1 - "An Amphibious Armoured Vehicle, a Bomb Robot, and a Life Raft"
st: An Amphibious Armoured Vehicle, a Bomb Robot, and a Life Raft
d: When a steel plated hull is fitted with controls on the inside and tracks on the outside, it’ll become the Viking BVS10 –an armoured amphibious personnel carrier that can get troops in and out of any combat zone, even if it has to go through snow, sand, or water to get there.

t: Battle Factory S1 - "A Helmet, a Zippo, a Fuel Bladder, and a Simulated IED"
st: A Helmet, a Zippo, a Fuel Bladder, and a Simulated IED
d: When a series of delicate snowflake shaped sheets of Aramid are pressed together, they’ll form a piece of headgear that’s comfortable enough to wear to war, and tough enough to take a bullet.

t: Battle Factory S1 - "A Pistol, a Firetruck, a Ghillie Suit, and an Armored Fighting Vehicle"
st: A Pistol, a Firetruck, a Ghillie Suit, and an Armored Fighting Vehicle
d: At the Cabot factory in Pennsylvania, USA, a block of steel will be transformed by innovation and artistry into the ultimate update of an American classic. The 1911 did tours of duty in both world wars and Vietnam, and is still prized today by collectors and enthusiasts.

t: Battle Factory S1 - "A Cannon, a Parachute, a Medal, and a Stretcher"
st: A Cannon, a Parachute, a Medal, and a Stretcher
d: A battle tank is only as effective as its gun, and for the Stryker vehicle, that’s the M68 105mm cannon. A tube of forged steel will be hammered into the one of the most powerful and famous cannons in modern warfare.

t: Battle Factory S1 - "A Grenade Launcher, a Flight Simulator, and Ration Packs"
st: A Grenade Launcher, a Flight Simulator, and Ration Packs
d: The M203 Grenade Launcher is a single shot launcher designed to attach under a rifle barrel. Using the latest technology, bits of plastic and a block of aluminum will be melted, molded, and cut to create a snap-on weapon that increases the firepower in a soldier’s hands by a long shot.

t: Battle Factory S1 - "Jaws of Life, a Tank, and a Watch"
st: Jaws of Life, a Tank, and a Watch
d: A series of handcrafted, precision-cut pieces will come together to create a first response tool capable of chewing through metal like a can opener. At the scene of an accident, a natural disaster, or in the combat zone, the Jaws of Life can cut through just about anything .

t: Battle Factory S1 - "An F16, a Sword, and Simulated Ammunition"
st: An F16, a Sword, and Simulated Ammunition
d: Brainpower and firepower transform 8,000 kilograms of computer-controlled machinery into a legendary dogfighter with the best fight and flight record in the sky; the Lockheed Martin F16.

t: Battle Factory S1 - "Camouflage Makeup, a Machine Gun, and an Amphibious Military ATV"
st: Camouflage Makeup, a Machine Gun, and an Amphibious Military ATV
d: Developed from solidified vegetable oil, this military grade compound is a long way from department store concealer: it’s sweat proof, infrared resistant, and stays on in the drenching downpour. For soldiers, especially Special Ops and snipers, camo paint completes their covert coverage.

t: Battle Factory S1 - "Combat Boots, a Pistol, a UAV, and a Riflescope"
st: Combat Boots, a Pistol, a UAV, and a Riflescope
d: For the soldier, the army boot is more than protective footwear. From the parade ground to the battlefield, the boot is a symbol of discipline and determination that marches the soldier right through his military career.

t: Battle Factory S1 - "A Rugged Case, a Precision Aerial Delivery System, a Military Survival Shelter, and an Armoured Per
st: A Rugged Case, a Precision Aerial Delivery System, a Military Survival Shelter, and an Armoured Personnel Carrier
d: Polyethylene is measured and molded, heated and cooled to create a rugged and air-droppable case that’s tougher than the rest. Stronger, lighter, and more durable than their wooden predecessors, these keep out wind, rain, sand, and humidity to ensure that valuable supplies arrive intact.

t: Battle Factory S1 - "Swiss Army Knife, a Sub-Machine Gun, Body Armour, and a Laser Sight"
st: Swiss Army Knife, a Sub-Machine Gun, Body Armour, and a Laser Sight
d: An iconic knife that’s been an integral part of military culture for more than a hundred years, the Swiss Army Knife has been put in service around the world – and even in space.

t: Combat Forces S1 - "Best Ranger Competition"
d: The US Army Ranger School hosts a 3-day competition to find the best Ranger team, testing elite soldiers in strength, skill, and endurance.

t: Combat Forces S1 - "Reconnaissance"
d: Reconnaissance units operate behind enemy lines, using elite training to gather vital intelligence and expose an enemy’s strengths and weaknesses.

t: Combat Forces S1 - "Coalition Training"
d: Allied forces train together to build teamwork and coordination, ensuring success in combat zones like Iraq and Afghanistan.

t: Combat Forces S1 - "Navy Boarding Party"
d: Modern naval boarding teams train to enforce embargoes, stop smugglers, and confront armed pirates in some of the toughest maritime operations.

t: Combat Forces S1 - "Airborne Artillery"
d: Airborne artillery brings heavy firepower behind enemy lines. At Fort Bragg, we witness elite crews train with precision, strategy, and skill.

t: Combat Forces S1 - "Pathfinders"
d: Pathfinders are elite paratroopers trained to go behind enemy lines, lead air insertions, gather intelligence, and execute high-risk, deadly missions.

t: Combat Forces S1 - "Elite Forces"
d: Elite Forces are specially trained soldiers who carry out extreme, high-risk missions anywhere in the world, anytime they’re needed.

t: War Factories S2 - "Battle For Black Gold"
d: The story of the discovery and exploitation of the Baku Oilfields in the Russian Caucasus, which forced Stalin and Hitler to face-off in the battle of Stalingrad.

t: War Factories S2 - "Fiat And The Fascists"
d: The untold story of World War II. No matter how many soldiers or how daring the strategy, a war cannot be won if there are not enough weapons or food.

t: War Factories S2 - "The People's Car"
d: The untold story of World War II. No matter how many soldiers or how daring the strategy, a war cannot be won if there are not enough weapons or food.

t: War Factories S2 - "Apocalypse Factories"
d: The incredible story of the arms race to create America's nuclear arms factories.

t: War Factories S2 - "The Kamikaze Bullet"
d: Japan would create arguably the greatest fighter in WW2 - the Mitsubishi Zero. But their failed War Factories would ultimately reduce the Zero to a Kamikaze plane.

t: War Factories S2 - "Dambuster Factory"
d: How the Lancaster factory, one of the biggest buildings in Europe at the time, helped to create a truly war-winning weapon.

t: War Factories S2 - "Colt & Kalashnikov"
d: Samuel Colt is the true father of mass production. Ironically, it was the inadequacy of Soviet factory production which made the AK47 so effective.

t: War Factories S2 - "The First Giants"
d: The First World War led to a number of astounding war factories, which laid the foundations and paved the way for modern factories of today.

t: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Hitler's Last Secret"
d: Thanks to secret, recently discovered microfilm, Hitler's last secret is revealed: a sprawling underground headquarters at Książ Castle.

t: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Mussolini's Underground Refuge"
d: 50 km north of Rome lies the greatest hideout in fascist Italy’s history: The Monte Soratte Bunker, with security features even a Bond villain could only dream of.

t: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Hoxha's Bunker Madness"
d: Paranoid and isolated, Albanian dictator Enver Hoxha establishes his bunkerization project, which would result in the construction of more than 170,000 bunkers.

t: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Stalin's Atomic Bunker"
d: Infamous for the bunkers constructed during World War II and throughout the Cold War, Stalin’s hideouts have maintained a shroud of secrecy for decades, and are now seen for the first time.

t: Dictators' Hideouts S1 - "Yanukovych's Hidden Palace"
d: Having stolen billions from the populace, Ukrainian dictator Viktor Yanukovych hides his treasure trove in a mind-bending corruption scheme that leads to Mezhyhirya, a 150-acre estate, with secret underground tunnels.

t: Bright Now S1 - "Search for Japan's Lost Supersub"
d: The I-400 was one of the Imperial Japanese Navy's Sen Toku-class submarines, which were the largest submarines ever built before the age of nuclear-powered subs.

t: Return Of The Spider Monkeys
d: This is the first-ever in depth film about the wild lives of the black-handed spider monkeys, and a stolen babies rehabilitation back to the wild.

t: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 1"
d: A rhino ear notching goes terribly wrong when a large bull starts attacking the drugged female. Up at the Animal Hospital the world’s tallest patient checks in and the struggle begins to get the baby giraffe to drink.

t: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 2"
d: Our vet Johan ends up with a buffalo up his backside when one of the animals they are testing for tuberculosis wakes up. We have a difficult decision to make, rescue an orphaned baby elephant or leave it to die a slow, cruel death in the bush.

t: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 3"
d: The wildlife team comes under attack from an angry rhino after releasing it from its holding crate. Our orphaned baby elephant is settling nicely into his new home and things go crazy when we introduce him to his new playmate, a sheep called Albert.

t: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 4"
d: Our vet Johan has to run for his life when a darted lion wakes up unexpectedly. The struggle continues to get our baby elephant Themba to drink milk. And the game capture team is tackling the world’s deadliest animal, the hippo.

t: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 5"
d: It’s a race against time to bring in the world’s biggest animal – the elephant. It’s gone down in a bad position and has stopped breathing. There’s a baby boom out on the reserve – we are lucky enough to watch the birth of a giraffe.

t: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 6"
d: An adult leopard has been caught in a trap on a nearby farm and it's a very dangerous rescue. It’s playtime at the Animal Hospital when Themba gets a new toy, and the work experience student almost ends up squashed by nearly a ton of antelope.

t: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 7"
d: Our wildlife team is in the line of fire once again when they become trapped in the middle of a rhino sandwich. Johan the vet has a rather tricky operation to perform. He needs to give one of our rescued lions a vasectomy.

t: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 8"
d: Johan crash tackles an adult cheetah after it fails to succumb to the tranquilizer and almost ends up falling asleep on the electric fence. Melvin, our baby giraffe is heading out into the bush to sample leaves for the first time.

t: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 9"
d: We need to capture five lions to move to another game reserve. Out on the reserve we manage to capture some incredible footage of a baby rhino feeding. And walking with hippo, how to stay alive when you are facing Africa’s biggest killer on foot.

t: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 10"
d: The Born Free lions are about to be taught a very important lesson that could save their lives. It’s all hands-on deck as the team struggle to push a rhino into a travelling crate and world’s deadliest cargo takes to the skies.

t: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 11"
d: Capturing a large bull elephant almost ends in disaster when it falls in an awkward position and stops breathing. We welcome some very rare and special new arrivals. White lion cubs have just been born at Shamwari’s sister reserve Sanbona.

t: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 12"
d: Johan has a rather sensitive procedure to perform. He needs to operate on a rhino’s penis. The wild dogs have escaped from Shamwari and the team must now battle to get them back before they start killing livestock on the neighbouring farms.

t: Shamwari S1 - "Episode 13"
d: A lion cub with a broken leg checks in to the animal hospital. A new bunch of ranger trainees arrives at Shamwari and we start putting them through their paces. They need to get down and dirty if they are to pass their first exam.

t: Engineering Reborn S1 - "Tate Modern, TWA Hotel, Tropical Island Resort"
st: Tate Modern, TWA Hotel, Tropical Island Resort
d: A power station, airport terminal, and airship hangar undergo dramatic structural revamps into world-class facilities.

t: Engineering Reborn S1 - "St. Louis Aquarium, Museum of African Art, Television Centre"
st: St. Louis Aquarium, Museum of African Art, Television Centre
d: A historic train station, grain silos, and broadcasting headquarters are transformed into state-of-the-art hubs.

t: Engineering Reborn S1 - "Maritime Museum, Coal Drops Yard, Peace Bunker"
st: Maritime Museum, Coal Drops Yard, Peace Bunker
d: A dry dock, coal depot, and Cold War tank shelter are reimagined into striking contemporary public spaces.

t: Bridging the Expanse S1 - "The Wonder of Bridges"
d: Pre-industrial societies around the world construct early bridges, reflecting evolving technologies and expanding human exploration.

t: Bridging the Expanse S1 - "The Elegance of Iron"
d: Industrial Revolution innovations in iron, steel, and railway construction spawn truss and suspension designs capable of spanning vast divides.

t: Bridging the Expanse S1 - "Baring All in Steel"
d: Engineers during the Great Depression design intricate skeletal steel structures, optimizing material efficiency to boost global economies.

t: Bridging the Expanse S1 - "The Making and Breaking of Icons"
st: The Making and Breaking of Icons
d: Wartime logistics and post-war suburban growth drive the creation of longer, functional bridge spans designed to handle modern motor traffic.

t: Steel Monsters S1 - "Antonov An-225"
d: Equipped with six engines, the Antonov An-225 transports massive electrical transformers across the high Andes mountains.

t: Steel Monsters S1 - "Steel Giant"
d: In open-pit mines, the massive F60 overburden conveyor bridge moves up to 90,000 tons of soil per shift to extract coal.

t: Steel Monsters S1 - "Stealth Technology"
d: Futuristic jets and naval ships utilize specialized radar-diffusing coatings and geometries to evade enemy detection systems.

t: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Son of a Sailor"
d: Dan and Francis pull boats for winter. Maxum replaces a ferry engine. Brad and Nathan face tricky container moves. J.P. finishes by greasing the boom.

t: Heavy Lifting S1 - "Under Construction"
d: Maxum swaps a grain handler, J.P. faces a tricky lift with a contractor, Brad and Nathan lift slabs in rain, and Dave visits a theme park.

t: How Do They Do It S14 - "Aluminium Cans, Cuckoo Clocks, Paddleboards"
d: An insight into how used aluminium cans are turned into planes and rockets, and the carving of a traditional Black Forest cuckoo clock.

t: How Do They Do It S14 - "Car Shredder, Sarees, Worcestershire Sauce"
d: How do they build the ultimate car crushing colossus? Plus, how do Lea and Perrins concoct their Worcestershire sauce?

t: How Do They Do It S14 - "Mardi Gras, Rock Candy, Dentures"
d: A look at how the amazing, and massive, decorations on Mardi Gras carnival floats are created, how rock candy is twisted together, and a look at how dentures are made.

t: How Do They Do It S14 - "Helmets, Tea, District Heating"
d: How do they harvest and treat the world's most expensive tea? Plus, how does the Siekierki power plant of Warsaw, Poland heat half the city's homes?

t: How Do They Do It S14 - "Royal Enfield, Art Fraud, Milk"
d: How do they engineer the latest incarnation of the classic Royal Enfield Continental GT motorbike? Plus, how do 'art detectives' spot a forgery?

t: How Do They Do It S14 - "Crash Testing, Delftware, Umbrellas"
d: How do they blend science and destruction at crash test centres? And how do they piece together the complex mechanism of a pocket sized umbrella?

t: How Do They Do It S14 - "Iron Ore, Wave Flume, Chandeliers"
d: How do they extract iron ore from one of the most remote mines on the planet? And how do they make chandeliers that are fit for a queen?

t: How Do They Do It S14 - "Oyster Knives, Stadium Lights, Diamonds"
d: How do they forge the blades to crack open oyster shells? Plus, how do scientists in a lab grow the synthetic diamonds of the future?

t: Future Warfare S1 - "Space Warfare"
d: Nations race to dominate outer space, deploying anti-satellite tech and space-based weaponry to secure the ultimate strategic high ground.

t: Future Warfare S1 - "Special Operations"
d: Elite forces adapt to high-tech warfare, using advanced GPS and remote tools while facing adversaries armed with cheap, off-the-shelf tech.

t: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Up and Atom"
d: This week's experiments blow open the science behind creating a glowing pickle, how forensic teams extract DNA, and how acids can transform simple household items to their core.

t: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Hot Hot Heat"
d: This week's experiments investigate how to send secret messages with heat, how a little bit of melted candle wax can turn into a bomb, and why heat is an essential ingredient in cooking an egg.

t: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Explosive Elements"
d: This week's experiments include recreating a big bang with lithium, the incendiary power of methane, and how a little bit of liquified nitrogen can lend a lot of power to a rocket.

t: Oddly Satisfying Science S1 - "Colorful Conundrums"
d: This week's experiments highlight how electricity can tint titanium, how you can create a color wheel by lighting things on fire, and why the world gets all its colors from white light.

t: The New Frontier S5 - "Increasing Orbit"
d: The ISS is the workhorse of the international spacefaring community, but its days are numbered. Replacement space stations are on the drawing board. However, with commercial interests these stations will add tourism and manufacturing to the mix.

t: The New Frontier S5 - "Mountains In The Dark"
d: Asteroids, the debris from the early solar system hold tantalizing clues to planetary formation. The spacecraft Psyche readies to study a unique metallic asteroid. As Lucy is on its way to the trojan asteroids that share Jupiter’s orbit.

t: The New Frontier S5 - "Oceans in the Sky"
d: Juice and the Europa Clipper are two missions to our Solar System’s largest planet. They will spend over four years studying Jupiter’s atmosphere, magnetosphere and in particular its icy moons, investigating if they hold oceans suitable for life.

t: The New Frontier S5 - "Webb of life"
d: The James Webb Space Telescope is now operational. Launched aboard an Arianne 5 the 10-billion-dollar spacecraft has deployed successfully and reached its orbit around the Sun. Soon Webb will make some findings and pose new questions to be answered.

t: Proof of Concept S1 - "Conceiving Consciousness"
d: Simone Giertz, Reggie Watts, & Naomi Fitter, join Dianna for an exploration of what consciousness is & whether it can ever be understood. Also, a robot tells jokes.

t: Proof of Concept S1 - "Randomness & Probability"
d: Comedian Maz Jobrani & Blackjack legend Mike Aponte play the odds, meanwhile, Dianna finds order in chaos, and just maybe hacks the stock market.

t: Proof of Concept S1 - "Truth & Logical Paradox"
d: Dianna dives through the looking glass in this paradoxical exploration of truth itself, where the left could be right, & right might be wrong. w/ guest Zach Pincince.

t: Proof of Concept S1 - "The Infinite"
d: Kyle Hill & Eugenia Cheng join the show to prove there is more than one infinity, that infinity is hidden all around us, & that we might actually be infinite ourselves.

t: Xploration Outer Space S5 - "Tales of the Cosmos"
d: Astronauts from the last five decades share stories of their adventures.

t: Xploration Outer Space S5 - "How Spacecraft Missions End"
d: Host Emily Calandrelli speaks to NASA scientists at the heart of these decisions.

t: Xploration Outer Space S5 - "Unique Space Jobs"
d: Host Emily Calandrelli gets an inside look at some of the coolest jobs in the space industry.

t: Xploration Outer Space S5 - "Extreme Labs"
d: Host Emily Calandrelli boards the world’s largest flying observatory, dives to an underwater habitat, and explores a laboratory nearly a mile underground.

t: Ancient Engineering S1 - "Secrets Of Notre Dame"
d: Building for God reached a high point in the Middle Ages when a new engineering movement emerged in Europe, changing the rules forever.

t: Ancient Engineering S1 - "Secrets Of Angkor Wat"
d: Temples, designed to honor the Gods, have been at the heart of cities since the earliest times.

t: War Factories S3 - "Rolls Royce - The engine that won the War"
st: Rolls Royce - The engine that won the War
d: The Rolls-Royce Merlin engine powered iconic WWII aircraft and became vital to Allied air power after early failures and major development.

t: War Factories S3 - "Enterprise: Rise of the Aircraft carrier"
st: Enterprise: Rise of the Aircraft carrier
d: USS Enterprise was the US Navy’s most decorated ship, shaping WWII’s Pacific War and showing how American industrial power supported victory.

t: War Factories S3 - "Skoda: the factory that fought back"
st: Skoda: the factory that fought back
d: In 1939 Nazi Germany seized Czechoslovakia’s Škoda Works.But under A.Göring’s covert resistance, the factory was used to undermine the Nazi war effort.

t: War Factories S3 - "Ferdinand Porsche: Nazi muscle machines"
d: Ferdinand Porsche designed major Nazi vehicles including the Tiger tank and VW Kübelwagen, but many impractical designs strained Germany’s war effort.

t: The Military Tech Show S1 - "Striker II, Navy Drones, F35B Fighter"
st: Striker II, Navy Drones, F35B Fighter
d: We have rare acces to BAE Systems. At their research centre in Kent, they're developing the futuristic Striker II helmet giving fighter pilots the edge in aerial combat.

t: Cold War: The Tech Race S1 - "Fuel for Destruction"
d: The atomic age introduces powerful rockets and nuclear energy, balancing technological advancement with threats like the Chernobyl disaster.

t: Cold War: The Tech Race S1 - "Golden Age of Science"
d: Military funding drives a boom in earth sciences and biological research, creating advanced weapons alongside deeper insights into our world.

t: Cold War: The Tech Race S1 - "Information Is Power"
d: Cold War secrecy accelerates spy tech, satellite surveillance, and early computer networks, laying the foundation for modern global communications.

t: Future From Above S1 - "Energy"
d: Pioneers explore solutions to power our planet, from massive renewables and grid redesigns to clean energy and ecosystem restoration.

t: Future From Above S1 - "Food and Water"
d: Vertical farming, ancient agricultural wisdom, and ocean desalination offer sustainable paths to secure food and water for the future.

t: The Lightbulb Moment S1 - "LIKE BUTTON"
d: When first presented with the like button Facebook CEO Mark Zuckerberg had a simple response: “No.” He worried that it would discourage more meaningful online interaction. Eventually, his team changed his mind and transformed the world.

t: The Lightbulb Moment S1 - "CUBICLE"
d: A futuristic designer, Robert Propst, dreamed up “The Action Office” as a workplace utopia that would unleash the modern knowledge worker’s vast untapped potential.

t: Extraordinary Humans S1 - "The Beast Man / Hawk-Eyes"
d: The people Thom investigates in this episode claim to harness powers that it was thought existed only in the animal kingdom.

t: Extraordinary Humans S1 - "Human Cat / Human Bat"
d: Thom meets a man who claims to be the fastest human on all fours and a man who uses a form of echo-location to see the world around him using sound.

t: Extraordinary Humans S1 - "Human Camel / Mega Arm"
d: Thom tracks down a man who has a right arm bigger than his left and sets another man the ultimate challenge to extinguish are using the water in his stomach.

t: Extraordinary Humans S1 - "Fearless / Iron Chest"
d: Thom tracks down two more extraordinary humans. One balances on the edges of the world and one attempt to withstand the weight of a crushed car on his chest.

t: Space Greed S1 - "Above The Law"
d: Who decides the law in space? And how will it be enforced?

t: Space Greed S1 - "Toxic Space Factories"
d: Will it ever make sense to use outer space to offshore human pollution and waste?

t: Space Greed S1 - "Suing Our Way To Space"
d: Cowboy hat-wearing billionaires have reasons for their multi-billion dollar investment in space exploration but it’s hard to ignore how much money they stand to make.

t: Space Greed S1 - "Will Satellites Help Us Save or Exploit Earth?"
st: Will Satellites Help Us Save or Exploit Earth?
d: Our long-term survival on this planet depends on advanced satellites keeping us connected and keeping an eye on the Earth from orbit.

t: The Flying Kestrel S1 - "Record Day - Part 2"
d: The Flying Kestrel takes on the final records attempts, and the shocking results leave everyone reeling.

t: The Flying Kestrel S2 - "The Crash"
d: After driver Jon Webster crashes the Flying Kestrel at 148 mph, the team must work out what went wrong and have to decide if the dream of a land speed record is worth risking it all?

t: The Flying Kestrel S2 - "The Rebuild"
d: The Flying Kestrel team regroup at Jon’s workshop as he shows them his new groundbreaking ideas to rebuild the car to give them the best chance at breaking a land speed record.

t: The Flying Kestrel S2 - "The Test"
d: The new version of the Flying Kestrel is ready to be put to the test at one of the most state of the art wind tunnels. Has the team done enough to create a record-breaking car?

t: Power & S3 - "Yabusame - Michael No"
d: Australian Michael No, who lives and works in Japan, trains at a 900 year old Yabusame school and performs traditional horseback archery during a shinto ritual.

t: Power & S3 - "MMA Ballet – George Birkadze"
d: George Birkadze from Tblisi, Georgia, practices and teaches Mixed Martial Arts but is also a world famous ballet dancer, instructor and choreographer in based in Boston, U.S.A.

t: Power & S3 - "Krabi Krabong - Kru Oh"
d: Pimmchana is the daughter of Kru Oh, a master in the Thai Martial Art Krabi Krabong, that uses swords and sticks. She is training to become the best of the next generation.

t: Power & S3 - "Okichitaw - Meegwun Fairbrother"
d: Canadian actor Meegwun Fairbrother overcame his substance abuse trough Okichitaw, a native American martial art using the gunstock war club and the tomahawk.

t: Angry Planet S3 - "Under Pressure"
